# IMANIGO

> IMANIGO is a sole proprietorship (Einzelunternehmen) operated by Lukas Imanuel Hradetzky under the registered trade name "IMANIGO" (not incorporated as a company). Services include custom software development, vehicle transfer across Europe, and authentic sponsored content creation. Based in Traunreut, Germany. Available in German and English.
